title: Oversight contract, version 2
description: Types served by /oversight/* and /api/companion/human/*. See CONTRACT.md.

rowId.description: The control's id in the service's bundle.

corpusRef.description: The Verify corpus control it implements.

ref.description: The record the subject is about, in the service's terms.

lift.description: True when the event asks to restart, false when it halts.

right.description: The provision that gives the right to a review.

independentOf.description: The people independence bars from deciding this event.

replacement.description: OVERRIDE: the output that replaces the system's.

conditions.description: APPROVE or EDIT: conditions the approval carries; they appear in the outcome.

now.description: The service's time when it answered. Deadlines, claims and review times count against it, so a console works out time left from it, not from its own clock.
The service's time when it answered. Deadlines, claims and review times count against it, so a console works out time left from it, not from its own clock.

signals.description: Oversight-quality findings that raised or would raise an oversight-quality event.

ControlSettings.description: A human control with its settings resolved: the control's human_config, then the pattern's defaults, then the shared defaults.

library.description: The library and version serving the routes, or the name of a hand-written implementation.

RaiseRequest.description: What a service raises; the library fills in the rest from the control's settings.

firstReviewer.description: contest-appeal: who made the original decision.

dedupeKey.description: Raising twice with one key adds an occurrence to the pending event instead of raising another.

matchKey.description: What a standing decision is matched on.

AiRecommendation.description: A judge agent's recommendation, shown beside the decision panel. Null when the control asks for none.

Condition.description: A condition an approval carries: what must hold, by when, and whether it was met.
